label: Earth
caption: Earth is 12,742 km across. We are diving toward New York City.
credit: NASA Earth Observatory - Blue Marble: Next Generation (R. Stockli), July 2004; NASA Goddard / Blue Marble: Clouds (R. Stockli, MODIS)
notes: Orthographic projection centred on 40.771840, -73.975180 (sphere R=6371008.8 m), north-up; 3540 m/px (effective source resolution ~3.54e+03 m/px). Sources: bmng_eq (61%). Colours tone-matched to earth-5000km inside its footprint; earth-5000km (down-sampled) is feathered into the centre so the dissolve has no pop. Measured registration of the raw sources vs the next level: -280.9 m E, +241.1 m N. NASA Blue Marble cloud layer, faded out within 1250 km of the target so the dive is clear. Simple atmosphere: limb darkening, blue haze and rim glow; black space.

label: Someone on the grass
caption: An adult human body is roughly 60% water by weight.

license: Pexels License (free to use; attribution not required)
notes: Straight-down drone photo (same shoot as `person`), 4:3 crop of the 4000x2250 original. Scale from body length ~1.68 m (~567 px); 2.96 mm/px. A small piece of litter (top-left) was retouched out. 2972x2229 crop; grass colour-graded toward the Sheep Meadow lawn of earth-160m (Lab mean [43.7, -17.5, 40.5] -> [38.1, -24.8, 27.7]). The person photo (same shoot, SIFT-aligned) is feathered into the centre for a seamless dissolve.
